Students may develop rehearsal, collaboration, interpretation and critical-analysis skills. The balance of disciplines, assessment and honours pathways differs by institution.

courses.name: Bachelor's in Indology
courses.summary: Bachelor's in Indology programmes examine Indian civilisation through languages, texts, history, philosophy, art and cultural heritage. Study may combine textual interpretation, field documentation and critical research methods. Exact language requirements, disciplinary balance and honours structure depend on the institution.

universities.name: P K Das Institute of Social Sciences, Health Sciences and Technology
universities.summary: P K Das Institute of Social Sciences, Health Sciences and Technology is a Coimbatore institution declared a deemed-to-be university under the distinct greenfield category in May 2026. Its own schools cover social sciences, health sciences and technology. The Social Sciences school lists four-year honours degrees in Performing Arts and Indology.
universities.campusLifestyle: The university’s Social Sciences school brings together creative practice and the study of Indian civilisation and heritage. Performing Arts includes music, dance and theatre, while Indology combines texts, languages, history, philosophy and culture. The university’s current site records its first-batch welcome and governing-council activity. Obtain the academic timetable and actual learning spaces for the selected programme before enrolment.
universities.cityProfile: The university website gives its academic contact at Nehru Gardens, Thirumalayampalayam, Coimbatore 641105, and a separate corporate office at Nehru College Campus, Palakkad Main Road, Kuniamuthur, Coimbatore 641008. The UGC register and Ministry declaration use the Kuniamuthur address. Confirm where teaching, practical activity and examinations for the exact programme take place.
universities.practicalExposure: The Performing Arts page describes training in music, dance and theatre, with performances and exposure to classical, folk and contemporary forms. The Indology page includes ancient texts and languages, fieldwork, heritage-site documentation and scholarly writing. Confirm the current syllabus, supervised activities and assessment arrangements; these descriptions do not establish a guaranteed placement or professional appointment.
universities.hostelOverview: Request the university’s current accommodation information, eligibility, allocation and charges before arranging a move. Confirm whether the offer includes a residential place, where that accommodation is located and what facilities are available. University admission and a group-institution facility list should not be treated as a guaranteed hostel allocation.
universities.dietarySupport: Ask about current dining arrangements at the actual teaching and accommodation locations. Confirm meal charges and dietary or accessibility needs directly before payment. A programme fee quotation should identify whether accommodation and meals are separate.
universities.safetyOverview: Use the university’s own application route and published contacts to confirm the exact programme, campus and beneficiary details before paying. Keep the written offer, academic conditions and official payment receipts. Obtain the current campus-support and emergency contacts when arranging attendance.
universities.studentSupport: The university provides a current application portal, admissions contacts and named school information. Applicants should obtain the required qualification-document checklist, entrance-assessment instructions, academic timetable and complete written fee quotation for the selected award. Equivalent or overseas qualifications need university assessment.

faq.question: Is this the same institution as PK Das Medical College in Kerala?
faq.answer: No. This profile covers P K Das Institute of Social Sciences, Health Sciences and Technology, the Coimbatore deemed-to-be university declared in May 2026. The Ministry order explicitly says other institutions of the sponsoring trust are not part of the university without Ministry approval.

faq.question: Which programmes are listed here?
faq.answer: The School of Social Sciences lists BA Performing Arts (Hons) and BSc Indology (Hons). The current named programme pages give each a four-year duration. These honours degrees should not be substituted with a three-year award from a separate college or an older listing.

faq.question: What does Performing Arts involve?
faq.answer: The university describes music, dance and theatre practice alongside study of performance traditions and stagecraft. It lists classical, folk and contemporary forms, performances and practitioner mentorship. Obtain the current curriculum and assessment plan for the balance of subjects.

faq.question: What is studied in Indology?
faq.answer: The course page describes Indian civilisation, ancient texts, languages, literature, philosophy, art and culture. Its highlights include heritage-site documentation, fieldwork, critical thinking and scholarly writing. Confirm specific language and fieldwork requirements with the school.

faq.question: What are the admission requirements?
faq.answer: Both current course pages require completion of 10+2 or equivalent from a recognised board with 70%, together with an entrance examination score. Performing Arts also asks for passion and aptitude in the subject; Indology identifies an interest in history, culture, philosophy and heritage.

faq.question: Which entrance examination is required?
faq.answer: The named pages list an entrance examination score but do not identify the examination, qualifying score or assessment schedule. Obtain the university’s current instructions for the selected programme before applying or paying.

faq.question: How much do the degrees cost?
faq.answer: Request the current four-year award’s complete written fee quotation, including tuition, compulsory charges and refund terms. A fee attached to a differently timed or differently named course should not be assumed to apply to these honours degrees.

faq.question: Where is the university located?
faq.answer: The university site lists Nehru Gardens, Thirumalayampalayam, as its academic contact and Nehru College Campus, Kuniamuthur, as its corporate office in Coimbatore. Confirm the exact teaching, activity and examination locations on the offer.

faq.question: What language will be used for teaching?
faq.answer: Confirm the instruction and examination languages directly with the university for the selected programme, including any specific ancient-language study in Indology.

faq.question: Can international applicants apply?
faq.answer: The current named course pages give school-entry conditions but do not establish an unrestricted foreign-qualification route. Applicants with overseas qualifications should obtain a written eligibility and equivalence assessment and confirm fees, attendance and any immigration requirements separately.
